title: Varioptic AF liquid lenses 'deployed since 2007' (camcorders, barcode, security)
detail: Laser Focus World: Varioptic electrowetting AF liquid lenses deployed in consumer/industrial devices since 2007.

title: Varioptic B617 smartphone liquid lens with OIS + AF, 'up to 90% less power' than VCM
detail: Second-generation programmable liquid lens for smartphones with OIS and AF; 'up to 90% less power' than VCM; sampling April 2011. No smartphone design win reported.

title: Invenios completes acquisition of Varioptic from Parrot Drones
detail: Invenios LLC closed the acquisition of Varioptic from Parrot Drones (undisclosed amount); assets moved to Invenios France SAS.

title: Varioptic becomes part of Corning (Varioptic + Invenios technologies)
detail: John Duke (Corning): 'Varioptic became a part of Corning in 2017 through an acquisition that included Varioptic and Invenios technologies.'

title: Corning Varioptic manufacturing capacity 'nearly doubled in 2018'
detail: Frédéric Laune (Corning): 'Our manufacturing capacity nearly doubled in 2018'; sales doubled over two years.

title: 2-millionth Corning Varioptic lens delivered (machine vision, barcode, medical)
detail: Announced at Laser World of Photonics, June 2019; markets named are machine vision, barcode and medical imaging.

title: Corning launches 2.0 refractive-index glass wafers for AR/MR waveguides
detail: Corning's AR effort is waveguide glass: 2.0 index wafers (150/200/300 mm) shown at SPIE AR|VR|MR and Photonics West. Not an autofocus product.

title: Corning AR Solutions page: high-index waveguide glass for 'leading AR/MR device makers'; no liquid-lens mention
detail: Page (release date in metadata 2023-12-19): 'first to market with ultra-flat, high refractive index glass wafers for leading AR/MR device makers pursuing waveguide-based designs'; supports 'high-volume manufacturing' for 'industrial and consumer applications'.

title: Edmund catalog: Varioptic A-16F 1.6 mm 'smallest liquid lens'; A-25H packaged lens 3.50 mm thick
detail: Current Edmund listing: A-16F0 1.6 mm CA 'smallest liquid lens currently available ... barcode engines, industrial and medical endoscopes'; A-25H0-P33 packaged lens Ø9.40 mm, 3.50 mm thick, -5 to +13 dpt, 'barcode readers, industrial cameras, medical imaging a

title: Corning Varioptic page: 'adjustable lens solutions for industrial applications'; V-PE-80R0 8-electrode lens
detail: Landing page (lastModified 2026-09-24): 'Market-leading adjustable lens solutions for industrial applications'; new V-PE-80R0 8-electrode lens (focus + astigmatism), new C-mount (12 mm) and S-mount (25 mm) modules, AF Explorer kit. Events listed: VISION Stuttg
